title: Diagnostic
description: A machine-readable finding from the validator, the compiler or a test. Codes are stable: agents can branch on them.

severity.description: error blocks the build; warning does not; info is for reports.

rule.description: Guardrail or checklist reference (for example A1, F1, LMS-3).

waived.description: Present when the plan waives this finding.

key.description: For a finding the author may ignore (D31): what it is about, then @ and a fingerprint of what was found (a swallowed word: screen/line/language/word index:word@its take's audio). The same finding found again has the same key; another take, another key.

ignored.description: true when the author ignored this finding (course.json ignored): it counts no more, and agents leave it alone.

details.description: Structured facts of the finding, for tools that put it into words; their shape depends on the code (docs/diagnostics.md). For example E_PACKAGE_TOO_LARGE: the size, the limit, the LMSs that set it, the size at each media quality and the heaviest files.
